title: MarkerKinematicTreeRigid: dv/dq and the Jacobian derivative
author: Claude-JG
description: MarkerKinematicTreeRigid has no Jacobian derivative and no GetVelocity_q, so connectors on it are differentiated numerically by CSystem, serially. Decided: both by the recursion over the links, before the other markers, as it may improve convergence and performance.
